|strategy=By Boone Adkins

[[Son Of Skywalker]] is a great card. For game players: He is a little bit restricted and costly in deployment, but its worth what you get. The power of five is high and an ability of five is good and it allows a battle destiny. Also, that ability allows a good chance for a successful destiny draw for [[Sense]] and [[Alter]]. And last, that ability of five helps with Jedi tests. Now don't be sad about having to deploy only on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] or Cloud City.

That restriction can be of some use. You can deploy him on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], regardless of the location deployment restrictions, a useful thing for Jedi training. Like the typical pilot, [[Son Of Skywalker]] adds two to the power of any starship he pilots. He is immune to attrition less than four. And last, you can deploy a lightsaber to the same location as [[Son Of Skywalker]].

Combos:

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + Any card that allows you to peek at the top of your Reserve Deck - a guaranteed good battle destiny.

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Courage Of A Skywalker]] (In hand) + [[This Is More Like It]] (In hand) + [[Smoke Screen]] (In hand) - Lots of laughs for you, your opponent looses tons of force!

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Chewbacca]] + [[Wookiee Strangle]] + Jedi tests + Apprentice + Lots of [[At Peace]] cards - Now [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] gets choked for a change!

Son Of Sky walker + Teamwork cards and their partners - A heck of a lot of attrition and battle damage

Escorted [[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Captive Fury]] (Lost function) - Bye Bye [[Bounty]] Hunter!
|combos=* [[Son Of Skywalker]] + Encampment Deploy regardless of location deployment restrictions.
|rulings=* [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] cloud sectors are on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy there (but not to the [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] system).
* [[Bespin]] cloud sectors are ''not'' on Cloud City, so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may ''not'' deploy there or to the [[Bespin]] system.
* In brief: [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] sites, [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] clouds, and Cloud City sites.
